title: Terms and Purrditions
status: Recorded first draft; 211 files verified; listening and shot-level review pending

scenes.title: Breakfast on Wheels
scenes.action: The five deliver the first community salmon crates. A family has food for tonight. Byte insists on keeping a receipt for every handover.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Establish the tangible success inherited from the pilot.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Easy with that crate. We rescued the salmon. We don't need to launch it.
The wheels are experimental. The brakes are more of a future ambition.
Then your future ambition is standing downhill with a mattress.
One crate, six households. Every delivery gets a receipt. Nobody disappears between columns.
You made a spreadsheet for breakfast?
Breakfast deserves better administration than this city.
Mrs. Fen's building first. She said the little ones haven't had a proper meal since Tuesday.
And after that, we finally sleep?
After that, you invent brakes.

scenes.title: Payment Declined
scenes.action: A customer can see funds but cannot pay. The clerk tries a second account; it is blocked too. Trixie recognizes the delivery recipient list.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: An account freeze turns the victory into a new problem.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: It says declined. You've got money. It just won't let me take it.
I checked this morning. That's my whole week's wages sitting right there.
Try mine. We'll sort it out later.
Yours is frozen too. That's the fourth one since you came in.
Wait. Same notice, same timestamp. Can I see the receipt from the failed payment?
Am I in trouble because you brought us food?
No. Getting dinner doesn't make you a criminal.
But someone just made it a reason to lock your account.

scenes.title: Sorry Costs Extra
scenes.action: The help terminal prints a thirty-seven-page apology and charges a processing fee. Onyx asks whether the apology needs an apology. Neon saves the reference number.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: A comic obstacle creates the evidence trail rather than delaying it.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: I found the help button. That's promising. Help usually means help.
Not on that machine. Stand back when it starts printing.
How long is this apology?
Thirty-seven pages. They must feel absolutely terrible.
There's the processing fee. Bottom of page thirty-seven.
They're charging her for being sorry to her?
Would you like to dispute the apology fee? Oh, brilliant. That has a fee too.
Keep the pages. All of them. This isn't just the shop's problem anymore.
And keep that case number. It's the first thing today that might actually be useful.

scenes.title: Three Locks, One Key
scenes.action: Byte compares food-payment IDs, the warehouse lease and utility access. The same corporate identity ledger governs all three. Ghost warns that an overwrite would destroy provenance.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Define the system and the limits of the crew’s options.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Food account. Electricity account. Warehouse lease. Different screens, same customer number underneath.
Not customer. Identity. They attached everything to one identity record.
So if they lock one thing, they lock your whole life?
Not automatically. Somebody checked three separate boxes. Look at the timestamps.
Payment access, tenant verification, utility review. All changed inside the same minute.
Can you undo it?
I can make the screen look different. That doesn't mean the shop will accept a payment.
And changing the record could destroy the proof of who changed it first.
Then we find the original order. I want the paw that signed it.

scenes.title: The Freeze Order
scenes.action: Barkington authorizes enhanced fraud review for District 7 recipients and an accelerated lease inspection. The public explanation is administrative protection.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Reveal intent through a signed fictional administrative order.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Food handed out without supervision creates expectations. Expectations create demands.
Mark the recipients for enhanced review. Financial access, tenancy, the usual precautions.
No, not the entire city. District Seven. Keep the filter exactly where it is.
We are protecting vulnerable residents from suspicious generosity. Put that in the public notice.
The warehouse lease comes up next month? Then inspect it this afternoon.
A lawful notice, delivered politely. I don't need a spectacle. I need them occupied.
And remove the word punishment from the draft. Have we learned nothing about presentation?

scenes.title: Receipts on the Table
scenes.action: The crew lays paper receipts beside matching account notices. Trixie wants immediate relief; Byte points out that erasing balances also erases the overcharge evidence.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Make the central moral and practical choice concrete.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: The table is officially full. Any more paperwork and we'll have to eat standing up.
We can't buy food. Finally, a problem that solves itself.
We have enough in the crates for tonight. We don't have enough for every night.
These are the delivery receipts. Every frozen customer on this stack received a crate.
That's a pattern. It isn't the signed instruction yet.
They did this because we helped. How much more proof do we need?
Enough that they can't call it a guess. Enough to get those accounts opened again.
Then keep the receipts. We fix the freeze, and we keep the proof.
Good. I was getting attached to being angry for a reason.

scenes.title: Keep the Evidence
scenes.action: They choose to preserve the signed account-change record and appeal the freeze. Ghost needs a legitimate copy exposed through a public service case; no magical total access.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Set a constrained, comprehensible plan.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Tell me what you need, not what you wish this system would let you do.
A real appeal number. The account holder can request the decision record through an appeal.
And a copy of the order before anyone rewrites the explanation.
We could just clear the balances. Give everyone a clean slate.
And erase who was overcharged, who paid, who still needs their money back?
A blank record helps the dogs too. Nothing left for anyone to challenge.
All right. No erasing. We keep the ugly bits exactly where they can be seen.
You take the appeal. We'll compare the records when it opens.
And nobody does anything that makes dinner depend on a clever guess.

scenes.title: Offline Does Not Mean Forgotten
scenes.action: Neon makes a paper-first delivery register. Onyx verifies names at the door. A resident fears losing access by being listed; they explain what is and is not recorded.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: The community gets agency and practical protection.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Name, building, number of meals. Nothing else goes on the delivery sheet.
They already used one list against us. Why should I put my name on another?
You shouldn't have to trust a screen you can't see. You keep your half of the receipt.
This copy stays here, on paper. We don't send your name to the news.
And if the dogs come looking for it?
Then we tell them it's a dinner list. Because that's what it is.
You can use your building number instead. We need to find your door, not own your life.
Building nine. Third floor. There are two of us.
Two meals. No lecture. That's our entire terms and conditions.

scenes.title: Take a Number
scenes.action: At the public-service annex, the number dispenser sends them to a second dispenser. Onyx starts documenting every rule instead of breaking the queue.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Introduce the service set and a comic strategy that pays off.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Welcome to Goodboy Global. Please take a number to receive your queue number.
I refuse to believe those are two different numbers.
They are. We have thirty-eight. We need a ticket to stand in line for thirty-eight.
Maybe the first number is emotional support for the second number.
There. The rules board. If they're going to build a maze, I'm reading the map.
We're not spending all day in here.
We might. But I'm making it their problem too.
I'll photograph the board before somebody changes the rules halfway through the queue.

scenes.title: A Fee to Dispute a Fee
scenes.action: A terminal demands payment before accepting a frozen-account complaint. Trixie finds the hardship exception; the terminal demands proof they cannot pay.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: A specific procedural trap increases pressure.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: It wants a payment before it will accept the frozen-account complaint.
Of course it does. You can only complain about being locked out if you aren't locked out.
There! Hardship exception. That's us. We're extremely hardshipped.
Proof of inability to pay. We just gave it that. It declined the payment.
Ask it to print the decline. Make the stupid thing testify against itself.
Paper out. Naturally. The most powerful corporation in the city has run out of paper.
Use the apology. Thirty-six pages are blank on the back.
At last, an apology with practical value.
Keep page thirty-seven. I'm not losing the proof they charged us for it.

scenes.title: Every Posted Rule
scenes.action: Onyx reads the entire posted policy and spots a paper-appeal option. He calmly refuses the express fee and requests the required acknowledgment.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: His patience, rather than intimidation, earns the case number.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Section eight. A person unable to access electronic payment may lodge a written appeal.
It says may. That's not the same as must be made miserable while trying.
Where do we lodge it? Every counter points back to the terminal.
Section nine. The receiving office must issue a dated acknowledgment. This is the receiving office.
You've been reading that board for twenty minutes. You memorized the whole thing?
I got bored. Then I got annoyed. It's a very effective educational method.
There's the paper slot. Put the receipt on top, then the account notice.
And now we wait for the acknowledgment. Their rule. Their machine. Their problem.
It printed one! Look at that. We successfully asked for help. Historic day.

scenes.title: Signed and Dated
scenes.action: The case attachment contains the signed freeze-order record. Byte compares its time to the public explanation and delivery receipts. They preserve an unmodified copy.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Acquire evidence through the established appeal, not an unexplained hack.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: We have the appeal number. The attachments just opened. Ghost, look at the first page.
Signed freeze order. District Seven recipients. Payment and tenancy review in the same instruction.
The order came before their suspicious-activity notice. They chose the people first.
Don't rename the original. Copy it into the evidence folder and keep the issue time.
Already doing it. Original, working copy, and a printed copy for Trixie to wave angrily.
Keep the signature page attached. A screenshot of one sentence won't prove the rest.
You think they'll say we made it up?
I think we should make that a difficult thing to say.
Good. Difficult is one of my better subjects.

scenes.title: Protection on Television
scenes.action: WOOF7 calls the freezes a voluntary consumer-protection review. Cut to affected residents unable to buy supper; broadcast stays in the physical television when viewed in-world.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Show the gap between official language and lived consequences.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Goodboy Global has introduced a voluntary consumer-protection review for selected accounts.
Residents are reminded that a temporary restriction is not a punishment. It is an opportunity to demonstrate compliance.
The company says ordinary shopping will resume as soon as the necessary checks are complete.
Voluntary? Nobody asked me.
They didn't ask the fish either. It's going warm while that machine thinks about your money.
My wages are still there. Every time I look, they're still there.
Put the salmon in your bag. We'll settle the receipt when they unlock it.
You could get in trouble for that.
Then they'd better bring a longer apology.

scenes.title: The Lease Clock
scenes.action: A notice on the warehouse door gives a near-term compliance deadline. The organic officer delivers paperwork, while the robot-factory design remains separate.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Link the warehouse threat to the same identity ledger.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.voice_name: Jerry B. - Gruff and Gritty Commander
lines.text: Compliance notice. I'm required to deliver it to the registered tenant.
That would be us. What's wrong with the building this time?

lines.voice_name: Jerry B. - Gruff and Gritty Commander
lines.text: Your tenant verification has changed. You have until the posted deadline to resolve it.
It changed because you froze the account we use to verify it.

lines.voice_name: Jerry B. - Gruff and Gritty Commander
lines.text: I'm delivering the notice. I don't control the account.
Then write down that we received it and disputed it. Both things. Not just the convenient one.

lines.voice_name: Jerry B. - Gruff and Gritty Commander
lines.text: There's no box for that.
There's a whole blank side on the paper. Be creative.

lines.voice_name: Jerry B. - Gruff and Gritty Commander
lines.text: I'll note the dispute. Keep your copy.
We are getting very good at keeping copies.

scenes.title: Copy, Do Not Erase
scenes.action: Trixie declines the tempting destructive shortcut. Byte creates a comparison package containing receipts, timestamps and the signed order, with resident details withheld from the public copy.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Pay off the evidence-versus-erasure choice.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: We can make their numbers vanish, or we can make their explanation fall apart.
The second one gets people their own money back. The first just starts another argument.
This package has the order, the issue times and the delivery receipts. Public copy has the residents' details removed.
Keep the full copy for their appeals. Nobody gets dragged onto television because we wanted a better headline.
And here's Barkington's signature. Large enough even WOOF7 can read it.
We can prove the restriction followed the delivery list. Don't claim anything the documents don't show.
Fine. No speeches about secret world domination. Just the very obvious local domination.
That should fit on one page.
Good. I'm developing a personal hatred of page thirty-seven.

scenes.title: The Appeal Token
scenes.action: Neon brings the acknowledgment and the preserved attachments back to the terminal. The receipt number unlocks a manual review channel hidden in plain sight.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: The queue comedy becomes the mechanism for progress.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Acknowledgment number accepted. The manual review channel is open.
Imagine that. An office that responds when you follow its own instructions exactly.
Attach the freeze order and the payment decline. We need a decision, not another receipt.
It wants corroborating transaction evidence from a registered shop.
The clerk's receipts. Byte is already there.
What does the timer mean?
The case closes if we don't finish before the office closes. Because apparently tomorrow doesn't exist.
Keep this session open. I'll call Byte. We are not starting this queue again.
I may actually eat the number dispenser if we do.

scenes.title: The Clerk’s Receipt
scenes.action: The shopkeeper adds a witnessed receipt showing the same customers paid normally before the order. The clerk risks extra scrutiny but chooses to sign.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: A civilian action supplies the corroboration the crew lacked.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: We need a witnessed receipt from before the freeze. Same customer, same account, normal payment.
I've got it. But signing this puts my shop on their list too.
You don't have to do that for me. You've already let me take the food.
And tomorrow? And the next person? I can't run a shop by pretending nobody's hungry.
We won't put your signature on the news without asking. This copy is for the appeal.
Then hand me the pen. And spell the shop's name right. They always get that wrong.
Thank you. I don't know what else to say.
Come back when you can pay. Argue with me about the prices. Normal things.
Sent. Trixie, you've got your last attachment.

scenes.title: Barkington’s Denial
scenes.action: Barkington insists the restrictions are routine and that no neighborhood is being singled out. A screen beside him shows the District 7 selection field.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: His specific denial can be tested against the evidence.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Nobody is being singled out. This is a routine review conducted without prejudice.
The people spreading these allegations would prefer that we abandon responsible administration entirely.
Of course the restrictions are temporary. They will last precisely as long as they are necessary.
Move that screen out of the camera shot. The district filter is an internal matter.
We will not discuss individual cases in public. Nor will we be pressured by a handful of noisy kittens.
End the statement there. And find out who gave them the attachment.

scenes.title: NIP7 Puts It Together
scenes.action: The British cat presenter explains the signed order and the timeline, distinguishing proven retaliation from unanswered questions. Residents are not exposed on screen.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Publish a clear factual win, not an all-powerful leak.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: The records we have reviewed show a targeted instruction, not a random safety check.
The order identifies District Seven recipients and links payment restrictions with tenancy reviews.
These families received food. Hours later, they couldn't spend their own wages.
We compared the signed order with shop receipts and the issue times. The sequence matches.
Does this establish what happens in every district?
No. It establishes what happened to this group. That's what we're asking them to answer for.
Goodboy Global denies that anyone was singled out. That denial does not explain the selection field in its own order.
Open the accounts. Let people buy dinner. They shouldn't need a television appearance to get that far.
Residents' personal details have been withheld. The verified documents and appeal instructions will remain available.

scenes.title: The Queue Turns Around
scenes.action: Residents arrive with numbered paper appeals and their own receipts. Onyx helps them follow the rules the corporation expected nobody to read.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: The victory is collective; the crew does not solve everything alone.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Is this the right queue? I've got the receipt, the decline notice and a very bad mood.
All three are useful. The first two go in the folder.
Write your own case number at the top. Don't borrow somebody else's. Yours has to follow your account.
There's a lot of us now.
That's why they can't keep calling it one confused customer.
Written appeals go in that slot. They must give you a dated acknowledgment. Don't leave without it.
And save page thirty-seven if they charge you for the apology.
I thought that was just me.
That's what they were counting on.

scenes.title: Access Restored
scenes.action: The manual review restores the flagged accounts. The terminal displays a temporary review decision, not permanent control over the ledger.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Resolve the immediate freeze within the established mechanism.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Manual review decision. Payment access restored pending case resolution.
Pending? Read the next line. What are they keeping locked?
The tenant review is deferred for thirty days. Utilities unchanged. They've reopened the accounts.
Not because we pressed a magic button. Because half the district is standing under their camera with receipts.
Call the shop. I want an actual payment to go through before we celebrate a sentence.
Byte's there. He's trying it now.
It worked. Money moved. Receipt printed. The clerk is complaining about the paper bill.
Good. Complaining about normal things. I'll take it.
Then can we leave before I become part of the furniture?

scenes.title: Dinner Gets Delivered
scenes.action: Payment succeeds at the shop and the delivery register balances. The same family from the opening gets supper. Byte keeps the final receipt.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Demonstrate the result physically instead of only announcing it.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: It went through. I watched it three times because I didn't believe it.
One payment. Please don't try a fourth time. We've done enough accounting today.
Two meals for building nine. Onyx has the next crate.
And Neon has invented brakes. Apparently fear is also an effective educational method.
They're excellent brakes. You put a large object in front of the wheels.
That's a brick.
A locally sourced, manually operated braking solution.
The little ones saved you a place upstairs, if you haven't eaten.
We haven't. That sounds better than another victory speech.

scenes.title: Thirty Days Is Not Forever
scenes.action: The warehouse receives a temporary reprieve. The crew celebrates a real win while acknowledging the shared ledger still exists. Onyx keeps the huge apology as a doorstop.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Close the comic thread and state the limits of the victory.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Thirty days on the lease. That's what the notice actually says.
Then we use the thirty days. We don't pretend it's forever.
The ledger still links everything together. We fixed these accounts. We didn't fix who controls them.
Can we have five minutes where fixing dinner counts as winning?
Absolutely. The apology is holding the door open. Nobody touch it. It's finally doing its job.
Dinner counts. The accounts count. The clerk signing that receipt counts.
And keeping the records means they can't tell us tomorrow that none of it happened.
I've got one appendix left to check. Then I'm eating something with no columns in it.
Please don't make a spreadsheet for dessert.

scenes.title: Redevelopment
scenes.action: An appendix to the account record marks District 7 as a planned redevelopment zone. Trixie realizes the freeze was a pressure tactic connected to something larger.
scenes.dramatic_purpose: End on the approved redevelopment hook, not the later BARK-camera finale.
scenes.status: script draft; shot breakdown and performance timing pending

lines.text: Byte. Don't close that appendix. Go back one page.
District Seven parcel schedule. Proposed relocation and redevelopment review. That wasn't in the payment notice.
Relocation to where?
It doesn't say. Just clearance phases and addresses. Our warehouse is in the first group.
So the account freeze wasn't just to punish the deliveries.
It was to make staying here impossible.
We need more than this page before we know how far it goes.
Then keep it with the others. Every order, every receipt, every lie.
There goes my evening.
You can eat first. Tomorrow, we find out who's planning to take our home.

new_set_required.name: Goodboy Global public-service annex
new_set_required.reason: Existing HQ02 is an executive lobby, not a customer-service room. Preserve HQ architectural language but create a separate service counter, queue and appeal terminal sheet.

continuity: Follows the pilot salmon recovery; preserves evidence rather than erasing debts; wins temporary account restoration and 30-day lease reprieve; ends with District 7 redevelopment appendix. BARK camera finale remains reserved for S01E08.
